title: Physics Quick Check
description: Three questions in the three Flooki question types.

questions.text: A $12\text{ V}$ battery drives a current through a $4\ \Omega$ resistor. What is the current?
questions.explanation:
**Answer:** $3\text{ A}$.

$$I = \frac{\Delta V}{R} = \frac{12}{4} = 3\text{ A}$$

**Why not the others:** $48\text{ A}$ multiplies instead of dividing, and $0.33\text{ A}$ divides the wrong way round.

questions.text: A magnetic field can exert a force on a stationary charge.
questions.explanation:
**Answer:** False.

$F_B = |q|vB\sin\theta$, and a charge at rest has $v = 0$, so the magnetic force is zero however strong the field.
